title: Parmigiana Bianca
subtitle: Layered aubergine bake with mozzarella and parmesan, no tomato
excerpt: Sliced aubergine fried until golden, then layered with mozzarella and parmesan and baked until bubbling. Richer and creamier than the red version.
sourceNotes: Southern Italian white parmigiana variant, without tomato sauce.

recipe.freezeNotes: Freeze the baked dish before adding the final parmesan crust. Cover tightly. Defrost in the fridge overnight and finish under the grill.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Assemble the day before and refrigerate. Bake straight from the fridge, adding 10 minutes to the cook time.

content.text: Parmigiana bianca skips the tomato and lets the aubergine and cheese carry the dish. Salt the aubergine slices for at least 20 minutes before you fry them. This draws out moisture and stops the layers turning watery in the oven.
Lay the aubergine slices on a colander. Salt them and leave for 20 minutes. Pat dry with kitchen paper.
Heat the oven to 190C. Butter a gratin dish generously.
Heat half the olive oil in a large frying pan. Fry the aubergine slices in batches until golden on both sides. Add more oil as needed. Drain on kitchen paper.
Lay one third of the aubergine in the gratin dish. Season with pepper. Scatter over some basil, a layer of mozzarella, and a generous handful of parmesan.
Repeat the layers twice more, finishing with parmesan on top. Press down gently.
Bake for 30 minutes until golden and bubbling. Rest for 10 minutes before serving.

items.symptom: The dish is watery after baking.
items.cause: The aubergine was not salted or dried properly before frying.
items.fix: Salt for at least 20 minutes and pat very dry. Fry in a hot pan so the slices colour rather than steam.

items.symptom: The top browns too quickly before the centre sets.
items.cause: The oven is too hot or the dish is too close to the top element.
items.fix: Move the dish to the middle shelf and cover loosely with foil for the first 20 minutes.

items.symptom: The mozzarella makes the layers slide apart when serving.
items.cause: The dish was cut before it had time to rest.
items.fix: Rest the parmigiana for at least 10 minutes after baking so the layers firm up.
